title: Shinonome Ena — Regretful Pentimento〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew...
I think I managed to cover up the hole.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Though it's just a patch-up job with a scrap of canvas salvaged from another torn painting.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay! I'll start with that undersea painting I found first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It was from the point of view of someone looking up at the surface. The play of sunlight and texture of the water were supposed to demonstrate my skill.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But it didn't go well. I didn't have any skill to demonstrate, so there were no surprises there...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But the worst part is that nothing I wanted to express went into this painting.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At most, all I was thinking was, “I can't forgive him”, or, “I'll show him”. It's so empty...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's why skill isn't the issue here. I need to decide what I want to express.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No...
That'd look pretty, but... It's not what I want to express.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A hand outstretched toward the faint light above. Determination to go toward it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I won't paint the whole person, just their arm.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At my current level, that might be a difficult composition...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I don't want to sink into despair. I won't give up. I won't stop...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There are people who need my art. They're the reason I keep doing this.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe this person isn't grasping at something, but already holding it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And they don't want to let go...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yes...!
I have a good idea what to do!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's still not perfect. The texture of the water and the light have an amateurish feel.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I finished it all the same.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess I wouldn't be able to face up to these old pictures without Kanade and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...
Now's not the time to get sentimental.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There are still a lot of pictures left to finish.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
For this sketch of a forest, I can...
Ah... The perspective is totally off. And the positioning of the trees looks kinda strange.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The paper's torn anyway, so I'd better draw it again from scratch. Now, what did I want to express with this one...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got as far as coloring this drawing of the sky, but then I gave up when it was the wrong shade of blue, and I wasn't satisfied with how the clouds looked.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm, the blue sky definitely needs to pop, but I also want the clouds to have an interesting texture, so I'll blur them a little. And then I'll...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Phew...
I think that's pretty much all of them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know why, but I was incredibly focused... Is it because I'm dreaming?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, all that's left is the girl whose face I never finished.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What kind of face should I give her...? I feel like I have so many good ideas now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on a little longer, I'll get started as soon as I've decided—

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Ena. You're back from that fragment SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So you're saying that until just now, I was in a different SEKAI made by that fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. Sometimes, fragments of people's feelings drift into SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku told me that a fragment can show you the feeling that it came from.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But the feeling isn't powerful enough to become a full-fledged SEKAI, so it just fades away after a while.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That girl was the only picture I didn't finish...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena...? Did something happen in the fragment SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, kinda.
But, I think it was a good experience.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... That's alright then, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for worrying, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... I think the girl looked something like this. But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's not quite the same.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I felt so confident about drawing her in that place. It really is hard to get a clear idea when I don't have the original.)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I'm heading out to the grocery store and wanted to ask what you'd like for dinner...
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That drawing of a girl... Where have I seen it before...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, this? I'm trying to redraw an old picture from memory...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: That's it! You drew her in your sketchbook, didn't you? Wait right there!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Ena, I'm back.
Here it is.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're kidding...
That's the sketchbook I threw out ages ago!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How did you have this? I remember putting it in the trash...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I took it back out, just in case. I had a feeling you'd regret throwing it away one day.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
You're welcome, Ena.
So, what will it be for dinner?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wanna have grilled fish, or maybe poached! Oh, and don't make it taste too strong.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, Madame.
Well, I'll be off to the store then.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It was torn in SEKAI, but maybe...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This time, I really will finish you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, what expression will you have?
